sources_considered.why: Separates training, research, and inference estimates and states their uncertainty.
Reports a post-publication competitor training estimate, while acknowledging its secondary sourcing.

evidence_items.locator: Opening paragraph; qualifications in Assumptions and limitations
evidence_items.explanation: The analysis distinguishes estimated training and research compute from inference. Its annual figures include months before the post and projections for the final quarter, so they do not establish realized post-publication training spending.
This supports the plausibility of continued multibillion-dollar competitor training expenditure. It relies on press reporting, does not cover OpenAI, and does not allocate spending by architecture.

metric_scope.metric: model training expenditure interpreted as R&D compute

unresolved_gaps: The reviewed records do not isolate realized OpenAI transformer-training expenditure after July 29, 2024.
The competitor estimate does not identify the model architectures receiving the expenditure.
The spending threshold's company and time aggregation remain unspecified.
